entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: Infamous vampire stronghold in Stensia, ancestral seat of the Markov bloodline, now a floating ruin.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Creator of the vampire race and builder of the manor; survived the attack and married Olivia Voldaren.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker who tore up Markov Manor seeking revenge on Sorin.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Edgar's descendant, leader rallying surviving Markovs.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi whose chaos corrupted many vampires.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: Artifact whose sundering preceded Nahiri's arrival.

events.summary: After the Helvault's sundering Nahiri comes to Markov Manor seeking revenge on Sorin, and wrenches the manor from the mountainside.
events.quote: wrenching the entire structure and a massive chunk of bedrock from the mountainside

events.summary: Vampires inside are trapped in the reshaped stone; Edgar survives and later marries Olivia Voldaren.
events.quote: Edgar was thought to have perished in the attack, but he survived and later married Olivia Voldaren

events.summary: Under Sorin, the surviving Markovs are rallied to reclaim their ancestral seat.
events.quote: the surviving Markovs were rallied to reclaim their ancestral seat

relations.quote: The manor was built by Edgar Markov
